chunks: He cannot be questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.

key_terms.يُسْأَلُ: to be questioned or asked for account
key_terms.يُسْأَلُونَ: they will be questioned (referring to creation)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is not questioned about His actions?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse (21:23) is often cited to affirm God's absolute sovereignty and freedom from external obligation (la qasr), distinguishing His will from human accountability. It underscores that while humans are bound by divine command and will be questioned for their deeds, God acts according to His perfect wisdom without needing to justify His actions to His creation.
